dispatch: DIRECT Agent calls (headless -p session: the Workflow tool is review-gated). Three mandatory stages preserved: 2 isolated reviewers -> 3 adversarial verifiers that reproduce -> 1 fixer. Scopes pairwise disjoint and declared in-prompt (L-016).

conductor_verified_directly: and structural spot-checks of 3, 4, 7 and the RV-1 premise

scale_note: The reviewed surface is ~4,000 lines of tools/ shipped across cycles 1-8 of this run. It had never had a review pass. Two of the eighteen findings were NOT adversarially verified (RV-17, RV-18) and are recorded as reviewer claims, not as reproduced findings.

findings.summary: CLAIM-GONE exempts M01-M03 from measurement on a premise false at HEAD; suite never runs for them; deleting the three live guards still yields DETECTION FLOOR HOLDS exit 0

Fairness: the tool's own W8-R1 text documents this mode and defers it to guard-inventory -- see RV-10 for that deferral also failing.

findings.summary: Deleting rows from the committed baseline record silently shrinks the floor; with results emptied it certifies a floor over zero rows
findings.verifier_note: Tested the strong way: committed artifact doctored in a scratch clone, tool run with NO flags (the exact run-all.mjs invocation), not via --baseline.

findings.summary: Identity control is self-certifying: only the verdict STRING is read; an identity recording 7 failing tests is accepted as GREEN
findings.verifier_note: Conductor discriminator: gitDependentGuards occurs 1x in the record and 0x in detection-floor.mjs, so it cannot be consulted on ANY path. The tool prints the 7-fail contradiction itself and rules green.

findings.summary: An internally impossible row (CAUGHT + green suite + empty firedGuards) is bucketed SAME-GUARD and printed as 'target guard fired on both sides'
findings.verifier_note: Conductor read :447-449 directly -- only the verdict string and the boolean are tested; firedGuards is display-only.

findings.summary: CAUGHT counts ANY failing test, so M07 trips the base-to-worktree citation guard on every valid run and can never report SILENT; its row is unfalsifiable
findings.verifier_note: Verifier corrected the reviewer's overstatement: at real HEAD two genuine semantic guards also fire on M07, so today's CAUGHT is not wholly environmental. The defect is that the verdict rule cannot distinguish them.

findings.summary: At HEAD the committed final record is validated by no code path: default trusts it via FRESH-BY-CONTENT, --remeasure declines the cross-check because the record is not at HEAD
findings.verifier_note: Verifier corrected the framing: --remeasure's own verdict IS live-derived, so a fabricated record cannot make --remeasure pass falsely. The defect is unvalidated-artifact, not forgeable-remeasure.

findings.summary: The verdict line interpolates the RECORD's sha under the label 'HEAD', contradicting the banner the same run printed
meta.baselineCommit is written from measuredSha unconditionally, contradicting the adjacent baselineCommitShort; detection-floor:249 falls back to that field
section.includes(quote) with no minimum content: an empty readme-quote body passes as 'verbatim (0 bytes)', defeating W-3's purpose
findings.verifier_note: Converse control confirmed sound (257-byte quote passes, 1-byte reword FAILs with correct blame). Verifier corrected a sub-claim: a bare fence pair returns null and the emptiness guard DOES fire; the vacuous pass needs a body of at least one blank line.

findings.summary: Count-floor detectors are one-directionally evadable: `120 < n` invisible, `n > 120` detected; section G prints a categorical ABSENT while section E lists the evading guard by title
findings.verifier_note: The evading guard genuinely runs, passes at the true count, and fails when the floor is raised to 900 -- a working floor, not a prop. Converse control: ABSENT is currently TRUE on the clean tree, so the published verdict is not wrong today; it is an evadable detector presented as a settled negative, and this run retired count-floors on it.

findings.summary: Inherits the caller's cwd, so run from another repo it measures THAT repo and emits a false statement about aphorism-cli with no disclosure of which repo it read
findings.verifier_note: REPRODUCED BY THE CONDUCTOR. First attempt was invalid -- the shell's cwd had persisted from an earlier cd, producing a FALSE NEGATIVE that would have discarded a true finding. Re-run with explicit cd, it reproduced. See D-R8-23.

findings.summary: The verdict's evidence line asserts 'static parse agrees:' unconditionally and printed it over 131 vs 128; the missed tests appear in no classification section
findings.verifier_note: Mitigation on the record: the per-file census line DOES print DISAGREE, so the contradiction is visible elsewhere in the same output.

findings.summary: gap 0 is impossible by construction, so 'THE GAP IS NEVER ZERO, AND CANNOT BE' is a tautology of the tool's own definitions printed as a measured finding, with an unreachable else-branch
findings.verifier_note: REPRODUCED BY THE CONDUCTOR by code reading: breaks holds only RED commits, the repair scan starts at b.idx but accepts only 'green', so gap >= 1 always. The conclusion may be TRUE in the world; the defect is presenting it as measured.

findings.summary: 'every case routes through a skip' is a single whole-file presence regex; with an unconditional third case it still printed 'contains t.skip() routing: true' and 'the 3 guard case(s) skipped there'
findings.verifier_note: Material qualification: the tool did NOT certify the perturbed tree -- the reconciliation identities independently failed and it exited STALE (exit 1), so the false prose printed on the way to a RED verdict. 'G=2 is right only by luck' judged slightly overstated. Whether the identities always compensate on a co-edited README table is UNTESTED and stays open.

findings.verifier_note: CONDUCTOR ADDITION beyond the reviewer's flag: the same stale pair is also at matrix-adjudication.mjs:449, inside a console.log in the CONCLUSION -- published text, not source commentary, and the worse of the two instances.

UNVERIFIED reviewer claim: a tool truncated to zero bytes exits 0 and reads 'clean' in a roll-up byte-identical to the healthy run's

findings.verifier_note: NOT adversarially verified -- filed honestly as unproven.

reviewer_passed_claims_worth_recording: mutation-matrix's identity control M00 is genuinely a no-op, runs FIRST, asserts a clean tree before running, and hard-throws aborting the whole matrix if not green -- so a suite broken for an unrelated reason cannot produce a false all-CAUGHT matrix.
applyEdits requires each anchor to occur EXACTLY once and throws otherwise; resetClone asserts a clean tree at the top of every iteration, so a silently mis-applied mutation cannot be scored CAUGHT.
Scratch hygiene is real: per-invocation mkdtemp deleted in a finally block; after a full --remeasure (19 suite runs) no residue and no working-tree modification.
detection-floor IS failable along the axes it does check: a SILENT row exits 1, a NOT-GREEN identity exits 1, a stale record exits 3.

The committed verdicts are not fabricated in SUBSTANCE: a live --remeasure at true HEAD independently reproduced the same partition shape (14 same-guard, 1 guard-changed, 3 claim-gone, 0 detection-lost). The defect is that nothing CHECKS this.

citation-rule-check's two earlier defects are genuinely fixed: wrong-side attribution now blames correctly in both directions, and the ancestor-repo anchor guard holds (a non-repo copy yields the honest 'could not be determined').

test-line-delta's headline +79 is a real function of git objects: identity revisions give 0, the responsible commit gives +79, and an independent git show | wc -l cross-check matches the per-file baseline.
matrix-adjudication is failable and converse-controlled: pristine gives CORRECT-AS-CITED exit 0; rewritten rows flip it to STALE exit 1 naming exactly the two broken identities.
run-all DOES relay a non-zero child exit and its stated ORDER matches execution; it covers every .mjs in tools/ except itself.
Zero dependency and read-only hold across all ten reviewed files: every import is a node: builtin, and git status is empty before and after a full run-all.
conductor_ruling: Nothing was fixed beyond P-3 this cycle. Sixteen reproduced findings against the run's own measurement surface is a multi-cycle fix program, not a one-wave job, and cycle.md routes unfixed REPRODUCED findings to the backlog with high+ also becoming known_issues -- done: RV-1..RV-18 filed, KI-38..KI-43 opened. The value of this cycle is the conversion of an unreviewed 4,000-line surface into evidenced, reproducible defects, and the falsification of the run's own headline honesty claim (D-R8-22).
